extracted.name: Mozzarella with spicy tomatoes & garlicky toast
extracted.description: Make the most of tomato season in summer with this simple recipe. You could finish with a drizzle of balsamic vinegar to bring out the sweetness
ingredient_lines: 250g tomatoes a mix of colours and sizes works well, cut in half
instruction_lines: Whisk the olive oil with the honey, vinegar, chives, chilli and grated garlic in a medium bowl. Stir in the tomatoes and season well with salt and pepper. Set aside, covered at room temperature, for 1 hr.
Toast the sourdough, then rub with the whole garlic clove. Put the toast on serving plates, tear over the mozzarella, then spoon the dressed tomatoes on top.
